method: Unmodified production build; one initial outside-tower pose fixture, then real W/S/E/click input through the door and all five levels. Camera target changes only aim walking/window views; no position or ladder-height correction after the initial fixture. Fixed 50ms reference timesteps are functional verification, not a travel/FPS/loading benchmark.
